inputs.sub_niche: neighbourhood beauty parlour doing festive and party makeup
inputs.target_customer: women 22-40, working professionals and young mothers, mid income, care about looking good in photos without spending bridal-level money
inputs.usp: owner does every makeup herself, 10+ years experience, uses branded products only

assumptions: Price not given, so [INSERT REAL PRICE] is used
Owner is comfortable talking to camera

niche_hooks: Diwali party mein sabse pehle photo kiski?

scripts.title: Ek aankh ready, ek nahi

hook.visual: Half-done face in the salon mirror, one eye glam, one eye bare
hook.on_screen_text: Ek aankh Diwali ready, ek nahi
hook.spoken: Ek aankh Diwali ready hai. Doosri dekho.

beats.visual: Close-up: skin prep with branded primer
beats.spoken: Pehle prep. Bina iske base crack hota hai photo mein.
Soft glam eyes, jo flash mein bhi natural lagein.
Hair aur makeup, ek hi chair pe.

scripts.payoff: Full festive look revealed in the mirror

cta.spoken: Diwali slot ke liye DM karo 'GLOW'.

shooting.phone_setup: Tripod at eye level, back camera, 1080p 30fps
shooting.editing_tip: Cut on every brush stroke; no beauty filter

scripts.audio: Trending soft desi beat under voiceover. Pick a currently trending audio inside Instagram.
scripts.caption: Ek aankh ready, ek nahi... farak dikh raha? Is Diwali aap kaunsa look try karogi?
scripts.why_it_works: Split-face first frame creates instant contrast and curiosity.
scripts.biggest_risk: If the bare side looks too bad, it may feel like shaming.
scripts.reel_summary: The owner finishes a half-done festive look live in the mirror. It's for working women in Sector 56 who want party-ready makeup without bridal prices. They're left feeling it's doable and affordable. We want them to DM for a Diwali slot.
